title: Governors Call for Increased, Aligned AI Policy Regulation
summary: The National Governors Association released new policy guidance around AI governance aimed at advancing it while protecting jobs. It highlighted the need for “clear and complementary federal and state roles.”

title: With Jensen Huang, Trump Strikes Another Blow for Billionaire Impunity
summary: Huang’s firing damaged something Donald Trump values even more than national security: the stock market.
author: Michelle Goldberg
